page.layout: Front cover of the binding only: marbled boards, with a spine carrying faded gilt bands and a fragment of gilt lettering. No printed text block.
page.notes: This scan shows the outside of the book (marbled cover and spine), not a printed page. The spine has only faded gilt fragments, roughly "...KEN" and "...RIA", which are not legible enough to transcribe with confidence. A small paper label near the foot of the spine carries a partly visible number (possibly "572"), which is a library shelf mark and is left out. No text from the printer appears on this scan.
